Place your BGM files in this folder with these exact names:

- menu-bgm.mp4  -> menu screen BGM
- game-bgm.mp4  -> in-game BGM

The game will try these paths first:

- /audio/menu-bgm.mp4
- /audio/game-bgm.mp4

If a file is missing or cannot be played, the project falls back to the built-in synthesized BGM.
